name: Popover
purpose: Displays a floating panel of content anchored to a trigger element.
scenarios: Show a compact menu of actions
Reveal filter controls next to a button
Display a profile card on click

description.description: Supporting text associated with the popover.

closeLabel.description: Accessible label for the close control.

states.name: open
states.description: Popover is visible and focus is inside.

antiPatterns: Do not use a popover for task-critical flows; use a dialog.
Do not open a popover on hover alone on touch devices.

a11y.focus: Focus moves to the popover content on open; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
a11y.labeling: Title labels the popover; description is associated.

responsive.strategy: On compact screens the popover is click-to-open and stays within the viewport. On larger screens it can also open on hover.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Positioning follows the document direction.
